name: Fuyusaki Aiko
source:
A girl who has a gentle appearance. Due to her naive nature Aiko isn't good at doubting people, and as such, the people around her are protective of her. In addition to this, she is a bit of a romantic, as she dreamt of meeting her destined prince after entering the academy due to the shoujo mangas she has read.

As such, when [url=/c125706]Haruto[/url] starts working at the dormitory, she feels like she's finally met her dream man. Initially she was quite frustrated as she felt like she hadn't managed to charm him. But then all of a sudden, their relationship deepens...?

[From [url=http://azarashi-soft-plusone.nexton-net.jp/garudoma/character.html]official website[/url]]
